title: Cat With Wry Smile Emoji 😼 Meaning: Smug and Scheming
description: The 😼 cat with wry smile emoji is a smirking cat. It signals smugness, mischief, sass or flirting. Learn how it differs from 😏 and where it is used.
summary: The 😼 cat with wry smile emoji is a cat smirking out of one side of its mouth. It conveys smugness, mischief, and self-satisfaction: the look of someone who got away with something or knows a secret. It can also be flirty or sassy, like a cuter version of 😏.
meaning: Cats have a reputation for doing whatever they like and looking pleased about it, and 😼 bottles that attitude. The lopsided smirk and narrowed eyes say 'I know exactly what I did.' People use it after winning an argument, making a sly joke, getting their way, or hinting at a plan they are not ready to reveal. It is confident, a little villainous, and almost never serious.

It overlaps with 😏 but is easier to send. The human smirk is heavily associated with sexual innuendo, which can make it feel sleazy. The cat keeps the knowing look and drops most of that baggage, so it works for sass and friendly gloating as well as flirting. When it is used flirtatiously, the tone is teasing and playful, more 'catch me if you can' than an explicit proposition.

The emoji has had a revival in meme culture, where its expression is prized for being so shameless. It turns up with absurd boasts, deliberately bad advice, and 'silly cat' humor, often to show that the poster is being ironic. Cat owners use it sincerely too, for photos of pets caught mid-crime on the kitchen counter.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It follows a brag or a tease: 'told you I'd beat you there 😼.' It can also flag that a message is a joke with an edge. Friends use it to own petty victories, and because it is a cartoon cat, the gloating usually comes off as funny instead of arrogant.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: In flirting, 😼 suggests mischief and confidence. It may follow a suggestive remark or a dare. It is less blunt than 😏 or 😈, so the sender keeps some deniability. Paired with a compliment, it means they are enjoying the game and want you to play along.

contexts.label: On TikTok and X
contexts.body: Posters use it for ironic bravado and chaotic humor, such as announcing a terrible decision with total pride. It appears alongside cat memes and in replies that are meant to provoke lightly. The emoji signals the writer is in on the joke and not asking to be taken literally.

examples.text: Guess who got the last concert tickets 😼
examples.meaning: Smug pride at pulling off something others could not.

examples.meaning: Teasing a secret plan, possibly with a flirty undertone.

examples.meaning: Mischievous satisfaction at getting away with something.

examples.meaning: Playful trash talk before a friendly competition.

examples.meaning: A pet owner narrating their cat's unapologetic misbehavior.

combos.meaning: Mock-shy flirting, pretending to be bashful while being bold.
Cocky confidence about looking good or performing well.
Two schemers in agreement, partners in mischief.

confusedWith.difference: 😏 is the human smirk and leans strongly toward innuendo and flirtation. 😼 shares the expression but is lighter and sillier, suited to gloating and jokes where the yellow face would seem too suggestive.
😾 frowns and glares, showing real displeasure. 😼 looks similar at a glance because of the slanted eyes, but its mouth curls up on one side. One is annoyed, the other is delighted with itself.
😈 is openly devilish and often sexual or threatening in a joking way. 😼 keeps mischief at a lower level: sly, not sinister.

avoid: Do not use it when delivering criticism or bad news, where smugness makes you look pleased about someone's trouble.
Avoid it in workplace messages, since a smirk can be read as sarcasm or as flirting.
Skip it with people who do not know your humor, because gloating without rapport looks arrogant.
design: A cat's head with ears and whiskers, eyebrows or eyes angled downward toward the nose, and a closed mouth pulled up at one corner. Fur is typically yellow or orange. Which side the smirk points to and how sharply the brows slant differ between vendors, making some versions look sly and others nearly cross.

faqs.q: What does 😼 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: He is being cocky, teasing, or flirty. After a compliment or a suggestive line, it signals playful interest. After a joke or a win, it is just gloating. The cat makes it less intense than 😏.

faqs.q: What does 😼 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: Usually sass or mischief: she knows something, did something, or is daring you. In a flirty conversation it is an invitation to banter. Among friends it is bragging for laughs.
It can be, but not always. The smirk works for romantic teasing and equally for boasting about a board game win. Look at what was said just before it.

A wry smile is a crooked, knowing one, often showing dry or ironic amusement. Unicode's own keywords for this emoji include 'ironic,' though in practice people use it more for smugness than for irony.
